gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:ai-bureau-config:POST /api/ai-bureau-config — upsert or save an IVR routing row (which phone-menu path the AI bureau caller presses). Caller: staff owner, admin, funding_advisor.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:analytics/youtube-connect:POST /api/analytics/youtube-connect — saves the org's YouTube OAuth credentials after a live Google token refresh and channel read; stores them encrypted. Caller: any staff role in ROLE_SETS.STAFF. Response never returns the secrets.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:auth/admin-reset:POST /api/auth/admin-reset — owner or admin makes a password-reset token for another staff member and gets the link back in the response (nothing is emailed). Caller: owner, admin.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:auth/invite:POST /api/auth/invite — owner/admin creates a staff login (name@fundhub.ai), returns the set-password link, and emails that link through Resend when notify_email is a real address. Caller: owner, admin.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:auth/magic-link:POST /api/auth/magic-link — client types their email; if it matches a portal account a 15-minute single-use sign-in link is queued as an email. Always answers the same 200 text (no account enumeration), 429 on rate limit. Caller: public.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:auth/send-portal-link:POST /api/auth/send-portal-link — owner/admin sends a client the portal sign-in link: queues the magic-link email and returns the URL so staff can read it on the phone. 409 when no email on file, 429 when sent a moment ago. Caller: owner, admin.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:auth/staff-update:POST /api/auth/staff-update — owner/admin edits a staff profile (name, email, phone, start date, booked-call text switch). Caller: owner, admin.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:blueprint/declines:GET/POST /api/blueprint/declines — Capital Blueprint decline defense: GET the client's plain-words view of a bank decline and plan; POST actions paste, record, link_letter, step, schedule, outcome. Client acts on own file (paste, link_letter); staff STAFF role for the rest; lender-book lines only for owner/admin/funding_advisor. Writes need a paid Capital Blueprint (403 otherwise).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:brand/review:POST /api/brand/review — moves a white-label partner's brand through review: submit (owning partner or owner/admin), approve and reject (owner/admin only). Only writer of partner_brand.approval_status; decides whether the partner's disclosure copy may go live.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:campaigns/connections:GET /api/campaigns/connections — a partner's connected ad accounts, verification state and launch blockers; no tokens returned. Caller: partner (own rows via RLS) or staff naming ?partner_id=.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:campaigns/link-asset:POST /api/campaigns/link-asset — a person says which creative is running on an ad and what our own ad number is; sets ads.asset_id and fundhub_ad_number (key presence = set, null/blank = clear). Caller: partner (own) or staff via partner scope. This is what turns on the ad label spine.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:campaigns/spend:GET /api/campaigns/spend — today's ad spend against every ceiling from v_partner_spend_vs_ceiling (breached, exhausted, approaching). Caller: partner or staff with ?partner_id=. Reports the mirror's spend, not the kill switch's truth.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:chat/ask:POST /api/chat/ask — staff chat widget: mode system (platform help) or knowledge (Company Brain search plus a written answer). Caller: staff in ROLE_SETS.STAFF; knowledge needs canQueryBrain(role).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:chat/portal-message:GET/POST /api/chat/portal-message — the client portal chat widget: GET reads the client's own thread; POST saves the client's note as an inbound message on their sms/email conversation, then saves an assistant (or canned fallback) reply on the same thread with status delivered so it is not texted. Caller: signed-in client only.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:commission-rules:GET/POST /api/commission-rules — GET lists effective-dated commission rules with tiers; POST supersedes one rule: closes the old row at effective_from and inserts a new row with the new rate and a required reason (tiered rules refused). Caller: owner, admin, sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE). Changes what every future commission pays.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:content/welcome-video:GET/HEAD /api/content/welcome-video — the hero video on the client portal. Without ?sig it needs a session (client sees own file, staff name the client) and answers whether a video is mapped, whether its bytes are in the store, and a short-lived signed link; with ?sig it streams the bytes with no session (the signature is the credential).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:creative/brand-kits:GET /api/creative/brand-kits — a partner's brand kits (palette, fonts, voice, asset count), filter ?state=. Read-only. Caller: partner (own rows by row-level security) or staff naming ?partner_id=.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:creative/library:GET /api/creative/library — the partner's creative library, filters state, kind, format, brand_kit_id, include_archived; never selects storage_key. Read-only. Caller: partner or staff with ?partner_id=.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:dashboard/kpis:GET /api/dashboard/kpis?period=today|7d|30d|qtd — company money and funnel KPIs for Command Center and Ops: cash collected, funded count and amount, close rate, show rate, cost per funded, new clients, pipeline movement. Read-only. Caller: staff session, or the shared x-dashboard-key header (which has no org and is refused with 403).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:dashboard/seed:POST /api/dashboard/seed — dev tool that injects a sample client through the real event bus: entry.captured, survey.submitted, booking.created, payment.received $32, diagnostic.paid, analysis.completed, decision.rendered, and (unless REPAIR_ONLY) payment.received $3,000, deposit.paid, sale.closed. Caller: staff admin session, or the shared x-dashboard-key header. The handler sets no demo flag; the email is sample+<stamp>@fundhub.demo.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:documents-download:GET /api/documents-download?id= — mints a fresh signed link for a saved document (the bytes still come from api/documents/[id]). Caller: staff in ROLE_SETS.STAFF in the same org, or the client for their own file. Every refusal is the same 404.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:finance/bank-accounts:GET/POST /api/finance/bank-accounts — a client's bank accounts entered by hand: GET the grouped surface; POST add, classify (personal/business/unknown) and close. Integer cents, NULL stays unknown. Caller: owner, admin, sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE), client must be in the session org.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:finance/cashflow:GET/POST /api/finance/cashflow — GET the day-by-day cash projection, payment window or the org's cashflow thresholds; POST save_settings (min buffer, confidence floor, settlement lead days, each with its own sign-off), save_reminders (dated payment reminders for a client), acknowledge_reminder. Caller: owner, admin, sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE). The finance-os-card-due-reminders job also writes cashflow_reminders.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:finance/paydown-simulator:POST /api/finance/paydown-simulator — cash split and projected pre-approval for a client given cash_on_hand; needs an active finance-os entitlement (403 not_entitled otherwise); no credit file answers hasPull:false. Computes only. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, client in the session org.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:hiring/apply (POST application):POST /api/hiring/apply — public careers door: takes one application (name, email, phone, role), burst-limited per IP, honeypot; always answers {ok:true, received:true}. Writes a candidate and an application in stage applied; decides nothing. Caller: public.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:hiring/decide:POST /api/hiring/decide — the one place a person moves a candidate: action advance (to_stage) or reject (written reason required); decided_by comes from the session and a body that names it is refused. Reject queues a candidate-feedback task for a person; nothing is emailed. Caller: owner, admin.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:hiring/postings:GET /api/hiring/postings — job postings and their sync state (?state, ?channel), last_error verbatim, application counts. Read-only. Caller: owner, admin (ROLE_SETS.HIRING). The SQL scopes to the default org (is_default), not the session org.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:inquiry-cases (clear_inquiry):POST /api/inquiry-cases action clear_inquiry — marks one inquiry cleared; when that clears its case it emits inquiry.removed on the event bus (which wakes C-03 and the funding path). Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, org from the session.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:inquiry-cases (create, update, close, mark_cleared, generate, gate_override):POST /api/inquiry-cases actions create, update, close, mark_cleared (emits inquiry.removed when Completed), generate (writes the removal letter draft from the credit pull onto the case) and gate_override. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, client must belong to the session org on create.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:inquiry-cases (send):POST /api/inquiry-cases action send — sends the inquiry-removal letter for a case: mail:true prints and mails a paper letter to the bureau through the mail provider with the client's return address and the chosen service level; portal:true records a bureau-portal upload; a document gate (SendGateError) names missing papers. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:journeys/run:POST /api/journeys/run — walks every journey branch through the real event bus and workflows inside one transaction that is always rolled back (memory provider, nothing sent), and reports what the code did. Caller: owner, admin, sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:marketing-flags:POST /api/marketing-flags — stores an objection pattern (belief, lead source, setter label, count, period) for marketing routing. Sends nothing. Caller: owner, admin, sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:merchant/events:POST /api/merchant/events — open API: a client's own merchant processor posts sales, refunds, fees and payouts into that client's Finance OS with a per-connection Bearer key (sha256 stored); idempotent on (connection, id); bad events listed by index, good ones still stored. Caller: external processor holding the key.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:money/accounts:GET/POST /api/money/accounts — the client's Accounts page: GET containers (people and businesses), unassigned accounts, billing; POST create_business, save_business (business info), create_personal, rename, assign ('Move to…'), unassign, add_account by hand. Nothing is deleted. Caller: signed-in client for their own file, or staff owner/admin/sales_manager/closer (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE_OS) for a client in their org; a body naming org_id is refused.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:money/connections:GET/POST /api/money/connections — a client's own merchant processors (Commas, Whop, open API): GET list and summary; POST create (shows an API key once), secret (signing secret), api_key (encrypted, then a short live pull), sync ('Sync now'), disable. Not Fundhub's billing. Caller: client (own file) or staff ROLE_SETS.FINANCE_OS in the org.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:money/helper (POST send):POST /api/money/helper {action:send, message} — a client (or staff role-playing) sends a message to the money helper; the turn is saved, queued for the helper brain, and answered in the app. The helper is shadow: it never texts, and a transfer is only ever a proposal. Caller: client (own file) or staff ROLE_SETS.FINANCE_OS.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:money/plan (POST mark pin):POST /api/money/plan {action:mark, source, pin_id, status: done|missed} — staff mark one pin, only through the source that owns it (a waypoint goes through completeWaypoint and its proof rules; a source with no writer answers 409 not_markable). Moves no money. Caller: staff ROLE_SETS.FINANCE_OS only.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:money/strategy:GET/POST /api/money/strategy — GET the payoff inputs and the plan for saved or default settings (highest rate first, card use first, smallest balance first); POST save_plan recomputes on the server, refuses a first month the cash cannot cover and stores the plan, whose steps then show as pins. Moves no money. Caller: client (own file) or staff ROLE_SETS.FINANCE_OS.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:paid-services:GET/POST /api/paid-services — the client's paid 'do it for me' dispute round: GET the price list and whether this client may buy and whether one is in flight; POST prices the round (creditor letter, escalation filings), records the request (idempotent by client and round number) and mints a hosted checkout link at the processor. Charges nothing itself. Caller: client (own file) or staff ROLE_SETS.STAFF naming a client.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:partner-brand/verify-domain:POST /api/partner-brand/verify-domain — real DNS TXT check that a partner's custom domain carries _fundhub.<domain> with its token; sets partner_brand.domain_verified. Caller: owner, admin, org-scoped.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:partner-marketing/generate-copy:POST /api/partner-marketing/generate-copy — rewrites the unlocked sections of a white-label partner's page with the writing model, inside the partner's monthly token cap and versions each section. Locked sections refuse. Caller: staff or the owning partner.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:partner-pages:GET/POST/PATCH /api/partner-pages — Brand Studio funnel page drafts for white-label partners: GET list, POST create from a funnel template, PATCH title, slug, status, body_json; setting status to published stamps published_at (the partner's public page goes live), unpublishing clears it. Caller: owner, admin, or the owning partner.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:pii:GET/POST /api/pii — a client's identity data: GET masked identity (last four) or the access history; POST reveal (full SSN, reason required, access-logged) and store (ssn, dob, addresses encrypted). Caller: staff owner, admin, inquiry_specialist, funding_advisor only. The handler and src/pii/index.mjs read, reveal and list by client_id with no org check, and no row-level policy on pii_identity was found in db/.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:privacy/erasure:GET/POST /api/privacy/erasure — GET what erasures were done (all, or for one client); POST de-identifies a client on an explicit written request: writes the audit row first, then deletes pii_identity, bank_accounts and plaid_items, blanks bank_transactions and clients fields, and returns what was removed and kept. Needs confirm_client_id repeated. No schedule. Caller: owner, admin.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:public/climate-match:GET/POST /api/public/climate-match — public lending-climate lead magnet: GET how many active lenders the book holds; POST runs the staff matcher over active non-demo lenders and returns a count, lane counts and 5 bank names (no odds, no amounts). With a name and email it also files the lead through the homepage-survey path (a client row and the entry.captured and survey.submitted events) and merges states and ad tags onto custom_fields. No auth.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:public/funnel-checkout:GET/POST /api/public/funnel-checkout — self-serve till for the /partner/ funnel pages: GET the catalogue and prices; POST {item, email, name, track} records a funnel.checkout_started event and mints a real Commas checkout for the self-serve items (trial, monthly board subscription; autopsy delegates to runAutopsyCheckout). The $10,000 partner entry is refused with 409. No auth.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:public/partner-apply:POST /api/public/partner-apply — the affiliate and white-label application form. Affiliate: self-signup creates an affiliate row and a login (first password returned once) and queues the affiliate welcome drip. White-label: writes one partners row at status invited plus a rail card, queues the partner welcome; no login, no brand row and no page until a human approves (approvePartnerApplication, called from partners/approve). No auth.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:public/slo-repair-checkout:POST/OPTIONS /api/public/slo-repair-checkout — the repair plan a $297 buyer picks in the /roadmap widget after the pull, repair path only: body {ref, client_id, plan: REPAIR_TRIAL $200 | REPAIR_DFY $1,000}; refused unless slo-status would show the repair offer; demo mode records a demo payment link and never calls Commas, otherwise mints a payable checkout. Credential is ref plus client_id. No auth.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:public/unsubscribe:GET/POST /api/public/unsubscribe — the door behind the unsubscribe link in every email: GET reports state only (a mail scanner must not unsubscribe anyone); POST withdraws email permission by writing the opt-out the send gate reads. The signed token is the credential; one answer for every bad link. No auth.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:push/subscribe:GET/POST /api/push/subscribe — web push for the client portal: GET how many devices this client has on; POST registers one device (endpoint and two keys, encrypted at rest). Pinned to the session's own client, no client_id parameter; staff get 403. Caller: client only.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:read/ad-books:GET /api/read/ad-books?group_by=lane|ad_id|variant|gate|entry|primary_offer|secondary_offer[&from&to] — booked calls and leads grouped by ad lane, ad id, variant or registry tag; unknown ad ids reported separately. Read-only. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, org from the session.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:read/closer-call:GET /api/read/closer-call?client_id= — the Closer Dashboard live-call payload (cockpit): everything the closer needs on one client during a call. Read-only. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, client in the session org.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:read/commissions:GET /api/read/commissions — the commission ledger: who earned what, basis, amount, status (pending/approved/paid/void), split, product at earning, dates; filters client_id and status; demo rows excluded. Read-only; a client session is refused. Caller: owner, admin, sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE), org from the session.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:read/finance-ask:POST /api/read/finance-ask {question, client_id} — answers three fixed question shapes (can I afford X, which card to pay down, anything else = thin_data with the reason) from the already-computed finance command numbers; never a language model. Read-only. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, client in the org.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:read/inbox:GET /api/read/inbox — every conversation in the company, newest first: who, channel, last message, unread/answered state; the staff reply inbox's list pane. Read-only. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, org from the session.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:read/invoices:GET /api/read/invoices — invoices with balance due and days overdue from v_invoice_aging; ?status=open means an unpaid balance; unknown status is 400; demo rows excluded. Read-only. Caller: owner, admin, sales_manager (ROLE_SETS.FINANCE), org from the session.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:read/video-stats:GET /api/read/video-stats — YouTube watch-time rows for the org's connected channel plus the connection's own health (state, last synced, last error). Read-only. Caller: ROLE_SETS.STAFF, org from the session.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:repair/generate:POST /api/repair/generate {client_id, round?} — analyses a client's stored credit file and stores the dispute letters it supports (cases, items, letters, saved letter files) and moves the repair card; mails nothing (repair/send is the human step). Honest refusals answer 200 ok:false (no_credit_file, no_violations, no_authorization, stale pull, identity not verified). Caller: owner, admin, closer, inquiry_specialist.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:slo-connections:POST /api/slo-connections — owner map of ClickFunnels funnel and product ids to a Fundhub product: what a paid ClickFunnels webhook is allowed to unlock. 409 on a duplicate map. Caller: owner, admin (ROLE_SETS.OPS), org from the session.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:social/oauth:GET /api/social/oauth?action=start|callback&channel=facebook|instagram|linkedin — connects a social channel by OAuth: start redirects to the platform with a signed state, callback exchanges the code and stores the encrypted token on social_channels. Not configured until the apps are provisioned. Caller: staff owner, admin, or partner.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:trials/dashboard:GET /api/trials/dashboard — the live screen a $297 Live Trial buyer watches for a week: counts of booked calls, spend (null when nothing has synced), bookings, plan and events in the trial window; no earnings claims, no lender data. Read-only. Caller: partner (own trial; a partner_id sent is ignored) or staff naming ?partner_id.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-2.json:route:waypoint-tick:POST /api/waypoint-tick {waypoint_id, done} — a client ticks or unticks one step on their own checklist; only steps that stay open until a person says so are tickable (paydown steps and the no-new-credit rule are refused server-side). Pinned to the session's own file, no client_id parameter. Caller: client only.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:creative/actions:POST approve, reject or archive a generated creative asset (clears the review queue).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:creative/generate:POST enqueue a Creative Factory generation job (image, video or copy) for a partner. The Netlify creative-job-runner claims it.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:creative/run:POST claim and run queued generation jobs for a partner (or all partners with due work for staff with all=1). The Netlify creative-job-runner runs the same path on a clock.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:dashboard/client-archive:POST {client_id, confirm:'DELETE'} soft archive: removes the client's cards on every board and stamps crm_archived_at. Payments, CRS history and the client row stay. Needs no open shift (board leftover). A client who pays after archive shows on no board.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:dashboard/pipeline:GET ?key=<board> the board as the database holds it: the stages in order, each with the client cards sitting in it (cards.stage_id), plus amounts, conversation and funding-round facts. The read every board screen draws.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:demo/mode:GET reads whether demo mode is on; POST {enabled} switches it; DELETE {confirm:'WIPE_DEMO_DATA'} wipes the demo rows for the org.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:documents-upload:POST multipart file: sniffs the bytes against the accepted types, stores it, registers the document, and raises docs.received so the reader runs.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:finance/bills:GET recurring bills detected from bank transactions (and low-confidence candidates, kept apart) or the charges behind one; POST redetect re-runs the detector.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:finance/containers:GET a client's containers (one per person and business) with what each holds; POST create, rename, assign or unassign a bank account to a container.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:finance/liabilities:GET a client's card stack and totals or one card's history; POST add_card, edit_card or upsert a position. The store's reads take no org, so the handler checks the client's org first.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:finance/soft-pull:POST {client_id, reason, cost_cents?} records one queued soft-pull request on a client already on file (a ledger row; it does NOT pull anybody's credit); GET ?client_id= lists the pull history.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:inquiries:GET ?inquiry_id= expands one row's attempt history; ?recent=letters lists recent letters (specialist desk only). POST {inquiry_id, action: attempt, confirm, or status} writes what a specialist did to a client's inquiry. The POST needs an open shift.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:journeys:GET reads the Journeys editor's saved automation step trees (client, setter, closer, advisor, affiliate, partner); PUT saves one journey. A journey's steps are live SMS and email copy and pipeline wiring. Scoped by org.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:lender-observations:POST log which bureau a lender actually pulled, or review an observation (action log or review).
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/ad:GET ?n= one ad number for the Ads drawer: 30-day row, Meta ads, watch curve, alerts and diagnoses.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/batches:GET batch history: every weekly drop and Write now, newest first, with counts planned, written and flagged.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/costs:GET what each paid job kind cost last time and the month and batch caps. Every cost line on the Command Center reads this.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/flywheel/campaign:POST {request_id, key} start a flywheel for an offer key: queues the campaign folder and owner-notes file through the repo outbox; wakes the worker.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/flywheel/spend-read:POST {request_id, campaign} flywheel step 6: reads the saved ad numbers for the campaign, writes the conclusion into 06-spend.md through the outbox. Free; no model call.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/funnels:GET where ads send people and which Meta campaigns belong to each funnel; POST edits a funnel.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/funnels/push-live:POST {request_id, id, confirm_url} puts a built funnel live on ClickFunnels as NEW pages after a two-tap confirm; queues job funnel_push and wakes the funnel worker. The confirm address must equal the funnel's address.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/health:GET the Command Center health card: clock and worker last runs, queue, outbox state, model cost against caps.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/meta/load:POST {request_id, ad_video_id | all:true} queues jobs that load approved ad videos into Meta PAUSED. This route never calls Meta itself; it writes the jobs.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/research:POST {question, depth, sources, max_cost_usd} starts a deep research run (one in flight per company); GET lists runs and reads one run's report.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/research/tweak:POST {id, note} a one-line tweak starts a short re-run of the same research question that goes deeper on the note.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/scripts:GET ?status=&batch= the scripts list (inbox, approved, shoot day). Hides imports and unreleased batches.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/scripts/fix:POST {request_id, id, version, note, make_rule} the Fix button: queues a rewrite job from the note and optionally adds the note to the rules file through the outbox; wakes the worker.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:marketing/settings:GET the marketing machine's settings (one row per company; first read makes the defaults); POST changes them.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:message-templates:POST save or approve a message template. Save changes the words and switches the message OFF (compliance_passed false) until approved; approve sets compliance_passed true, which is the whole send gate; rename and delete are refused. The template editor's write door.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/client-progress:GET every fact the client progress page draws: scores, checklist, next step. Facts, not copy; the page renders the words.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/closer-now:GET which call this closer is on and what is next. Scoped to the signed-in staff member.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/conversations:GET ?client_id= (required) the Closer Dashboard pre-call panel: one row per thread with the last contact channel and summary.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/entitlements:GET what a client holds and what is still locked (the portal upsell surface and the staff view).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/finance-command:GET ?days= the roll-up dashboard: total cash, credit available and owed, utilization, investments, cash in versus out, and marketing spend, across the org or one client or entity.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/funding-rounds:GET funding rounds: submitted, approved and funded amounts, status, hold reason, conditions. Optional ?include_matches=1 with a client adds lender matches.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/lender-matches:GET ?client_id= lenders that fit a client's underwrite and inquiry profile for round planning (structural filters: state, inquiry sensitivity, bureau rotation). Returns 0 when the lender table is empty; never invents names.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/message-templates:GET the message copy library the template editor reads, with each row's body and who uses it (journeys, staff).

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/partners:GET white-label partners with accrued balance (rate is per-partner config). Partners are confined to their own row through src/partners/scope.mjs.
gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/sales-floor:GET the sales manager floor view: call outcomes, deposits and totals across closers.

gap-door-batch-routes:catalog-route:routes-3.json:route:read/underwrite:GET ?client_id= the UnderwriteIQ funding read: the engine's assessment, its sentences verbatim, the numbers behind each sentence, and the fields the owner has not entered.
